description: Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.3: RDR2-style over-the-shoulder third-person camera; optional add-on to Horsing Around

mods.name: Horsing Around: Over the Shoulder
mods.description: Red Dead style over-the-shoulder third-person camera. Works on its own; with Horsing Around it takes over the riding camera too.

releases.notes:
First test build of Horsing Around: Over the Shoulder: a Red Dead Redemption 2 style over-the-shoulder third-person camera. It works on its own, and with [Horsing Around](https://github.com/GabePurc/horsing-around/releases/tag/v0.1.0) it takes over the riding camera too.

## Requirements
- Minecraft 26.3
- Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) (0.162.0+26.3 or newer)
- Java 25

Optional: [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) for the settings screen.

## Installing
Client only: put `horsing-around-shoulder-0.1.0.jar` and Fabric API in your own `mods` folder. The server doesn't need it, and other players don't need it either.

Shoulder Surfing Reloaded does the same job; if both are installed, Shoulder Surfing takes the camera whenever it's on.
